0022600150.text: The Grizzlies (4-0) host the Sacramento Kings (0-5) with Memphis on a four-game winning streak, going 3-0 on the road and 1-0 at home, and sitting 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 3rd in the West. Sacramento has lost all five of its games, is 0-2 at home and 0-3 on the road, and sits 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West, with Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) all out. Memphis leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 123-112 win in Sacramento on October 25, and the Grizzlies also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
